senses.gloss:
r. 5th cl. (तिग्नोति)
1 To go or move.
2 To assail.
3 To seek to injure, to attempt to kill, &c. also तिक.

mfn. (-ग्मः-ग्मा-ग्मं)
1 Hot.
2 Pungent, acrid.
3 Sharp, (as a weapon.)
4 Passionate, hasty.
n. (-ग्मं)
Heat; also the heat of spices, or pungency.
E.
तिज to sharpen, Uṇādi affix मक्.

f. (-ता)
1 Sharpness.
2 Pungency.
3 Heat.
4 Passion, petulance.
E.
तल added to तिग्म; also with त्व, तिग्मत्वं.

mfn. (-रुक्)
1 Bright, shining.
2 Hot.
m. (रुक्)
The sun.
E.
तिग्म, and रुच् light.

m. (-शुः)
The sun.
E.
तिग्म hot, and अंश्रु a ray; also similar compounds, as तिग्मकर, तिग्मरश्मि.
